title: How to Fix a Dripping Tap in 10 Minutes
hook: This tap has dripped for a year. In ten minutes and with one spanner, I will fix it, and show the cheap part that actually failed.
description:
How to fix a dripping tap with one spanner and a 2 euro washer. Step by step, no plumber needed, tested on three common tap types.

Chapters:
0:00 Why it drips
0:40 Turn off the water
2:10 Remove the handle
4:30 Replace the washer
8:00 Test it

Tools used: adjustable spanner, flat screwdriver.

#plumbing #diy
